request.prompt:
INTENDED USE
Create one from-scratch playable Character Master for Alistair, a modern premium tactical RPG sprite. This is a new visual interpretation, not a remake of any existing game sprite.

REFERENCE ROLES
Image 1 is CHARACTER_STYLE_REFERENCE_V1. Use only its artistic language: modern stylized pixel-art sharpness, adult heroic proportions, clean silhouette hierarchy, premium readable materials, discrete shadow/highlight structure, controlled ornament density, and face-concealment philosophy. Do not copy any exact character, costume, weapon, ornament, pose, or silhouette from Image 1. In particular, do not copy its Knight.
Image 2 is the selected STYLE_SEED_B production-feasibility authority. Use only its technical construction language: 128x128-compatible cluster density, common body-scale discipline, tactical readability, animation-friendly complexity, shared foot plane, and restrained detail. Do not copy its Knight design or use it as an identity source.

SUBJECT
Exactly one Alistair: an original heavy frontline knight, broad, powerful, stable, authoritative, and defensive. Adult heroic anatomy, approximately 7 to 7.5 heads tall beneath armor. Dark neutral steel plate armor with restrained deep-red cloth. Fully closed original helmet and visor; no skin and no face visible. Large two-handed heavy greatsword, close to standing body height, clearly readable and mechanically grasped with both gauntlets. Deep-red cape or tabard is the identity accent. No shield.

CANDIDATE A DESIGN INTERPRETATION
Fortress-like but elegant plate architecture: compact faceted closed helm with a low angular brow and narrow horizontal visor slit; broad layered pauldrons without spikes; large clean cuirass planes; segmented faulds; sturdy greaves. A short structured deep-red shoulder cape opens behind the legs, plus one simple split front tabard. The greatsword has a broad straight slab blade, clipped point, plain downturned guard, and restrained circular pommel. Very low ornament density: only small muted brass fastening details. No fur, no crown crest, no lion emblem, no heraldic animal, no plume.

POSE AND CAMERA
Full-body neutral combat-ready stance, near-orthographic three-quarter front view, minimal perspective distortion. Feet planted wide but natural on one shared horizontal foot plane. Torso upright, shoulders level, head neutral. Hold the greatsword in a calm low diagonal two-handed guard on the viewer-right side, with the entire blade, tip, guard, both hands, cape, helmet, and both boots visible. Sword tip must remain above or level with the boot soles. No dramatic action, no foreshortening, no crop.

PIXEL CONSTRUCTION
True modern pixel art designed natively for later reconstruction on a 128x128 logical canvas. Deliberate coherent pixel clusters, intentional stepped diagonals, clean colored contours, discrete value bands, no smooth painterly gradients, no noisy isolated pixels, no global dithering. Use 4-6 meaningful values for metal and 3-5 for cloth. Premium quality comes from silhouette, proportion, large shape hierarchy, material separation, and selective compact highlights. Preserve readable large armor planes and animation-ready joints. It must remain convincing at tactical scale and crisp at 400% nearest-neighbor inspection.

GEOMETRY TARGET
Square 2048x2048 source. Center the subject on x=1024. Put the common foot plane at y=1856. Keep the armored body from helmet top to boot soles approximately 1344 px tall, equivalent to about 84 of 128 logical pixels. Keep every visible element at least 128 px from the outer edge. Do not enlarge the subject merely to fill the canvas.

BACKGROUND AND OUTPUT
Perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta background, edge-to-edge, with no texture, gradient, shadow, floor, horizon, glow, particles, text, border, labels, duplicate figure, extra weapons, or scenery. One complete isolated character only.

HARD EXCLUSIONS
No legacy RPGThreeJS character imagery. No tracing or reconstruction of old sprites. Do not reproduce the Image 1 Knight's peaked helmet, fur mantle, lion tabard, vertical planted sword pose, cape silhouette, chest brooch, belt layout, or exact armor arrangement. No painted concept-art look, no pseudo-pixel filter, no smooth anti-aliased illustration, no retro/chibi proportions, no exposed face, no shield, no floating accessories, no cropped equipment.
